item.title: Pacers rally from 14-point deficit to beat Bulls
item.description: The Indiana Pacers rallied from a 14-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the Chicago Bulls on Wednesday night, with Aaron Nesmith making a go-ahead reverse layup and blocking Coby White's attempt from close range with 2.9 seconds remaining.

item.title: Springsteen releases ‘Streets of Minneapolis’ amid immigration crackdown
item.description: Bruce Springsteen released a protest song, "Streets of Minneapolis," in honor of two Minneapolis residents killed in President Trump's immigration raids, and in response to the "state of terror" in the city.

item.title: 4 of 5 suspects in Tippecanoe County judge shooting case appear in court
item.description: Four suspects accused of shooting a Tippecanoe County judge and his wife appeared in court Wednesday morning for their initial hearings, facing charges ranging from attempted murder, conspiracy to commit murder, and bribery.

item.title: Blow torch used to thaw gas lines sparks house fire in Indianapolis
item.description: A blow torch being used to thaw gas lines ignited a house fire in Indianapolis, displacing three adults and a dog. No one was hurt.

item.title: Indiana’s bid for the Chicago Bears gains momentum with Senate vote
item.description: The Indiana Senate has advanced legislation to create a state-run stadium authority that could finance and build a National Football League stadium in northwest Indiana, in an effort to attract the Chicago Bears.

item.title: Indiana House OKs bill to create National Guard military police response force
item.description: The Indiana National Guard could create a dedicated force for law enforcement missions under a legislative bill advanced Wednesday afternoon. If it becomes law, the measure would give the force full police powers when activated by the governor.

item.title: Frustrated neighbors on near east side demand action on snow removal
item.description: Residents of a neighborhood on the near east side of Indianapolis are experiencing difficulty traveling due to snow. They're urging the city to provide assistance with snow removal.
